name: Asher
summary: A son of Jacob, born to Zilpah, Leah's maid. Jacob said Asher's bread would be rich and he would give food fit for kings.

key_moments.title: Born to Zilpah
key_moments.description: Zilpah, Leah's maid, bore Jacob a second son. Leah said she was happy, for the daughters would call her blessed, and named him Asher.

key_moments.title: Goes Down to Egypt
key_moments.description: Asher went down to Egypt with his father Jacob and the whole family, along with his sons.

key_moments.title: Blessed by Jacob
key_moments.description: Jacob said that out of Asher his bread would be fat, and he would yield royal dainties.
